**Suggested Week 11 starters, pending injury news:** Stroud; **Gibbs and Coleman**; Nico and Tet; McBride; **Tyson and Jamo** at FLEX, with Keenan Allen the first alternative if practice/route usage indicates a bigger role. **Denver D/ST** is available to start; decide whether to keep Colts only if a genuinely useful future matchup justifies occupying a bench slot. Emmett's 35.1 was driven by Kenneth Walker III's absence and should not be extrapolated as a regular RB2 workload. If Walker remains sidelined, reassess Emmett as an RB2/FLEX immediately.

## Waivers — confirmed available in *your* league
The connected free-agent inventory is an available-player list, not a ranking by fantasy quality. These names were verified available at retrieval; recheck before submitting claims.

**Strong adds, in priority order:**
1. **Justin Herbert (QB, LAC)** — unusually strong available QB in a 12-team league. Worth a claim as a high-quality Stroud alternative or trade asset; don't pay a premium for a second QB if RB help is available instead.
2. **Courtland Sutton (WR, DEN)** — surprisingly available; target for WR depth or potential FLEX upgrade. More useful than carrying two defenses.
3. **Brian Thomas Jr. (WR, JAX)** — high-upside rebound stash; volatility makes him a secondary priority to Sutton for immediate floor.
4. **Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST** — viable streaming/season-long alternative if the matchup suits; not a priority over a high-upside skill player.
5. **Seth McGowan (RB, IND)** — speculative RB depth with opportunity-dependent upside; evaluate Indianapolis backfield usage before starting.
6. **J.K. Dobbins (RB, DEN)** — available and relevant insurance to Jonah Coleman; role/health verification required before spending a high claim.

**Speculative watch list, not priority claims:** Xavier Worthy (WR, KC), Pat Bryant (WR, DEN), Elic Ayomanor (WR, TEN), Xavier Hutchinson (WR, HOU; concussion designation), Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC), Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS), and Cam Ward (QB, TEN). Also available: Bo Nix, Baker Mayfield (questionable), Mark Andrews, Oronde Gadsden, San Francisco D/ST. Several prominent names on the inventory have serious injuries, including De'Von Achane (IR), Jalen Hurts (IR), and Terry McLaurin (IR); do not mistake availability for usability.

**Recommended drops:** First **Indianapolis D/ST** if keeping Denver, or vice versa if a matchup demands it. **Tyler Allgeier** is the next expendable bench candidate if his touches remain marginal (1.4 Week 10 points); do not cut Emmett before Kenneth Walker's Week 11 status is clear. **Keep Love in IR**, Gibbs, Coleman, Nico, Tet, McBride, Tyson and Jamo. Montgomery is a hold while return timing becomes clearer.

## Week 11 byes and trade window
**Falcons, Browns, Packers, Rams, Patriots and Seahawks are on bye in Week 11.** That directly affects opponents with Bijan Robinson, Kyren Williams, and Zach Charbonnet. Your Week 11 opponent has Charbonnet in a preliminary RB slot and must replace him. Source (Nov 16): https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/week-11-waiver-wire-pickups-020613348.html

**Trade deadline is Week 11** per league settings; the connector does not supply an exact cutoff clock time. Check Sleeper before sending a time-sensitive offer.

**Trade approach:** Hold Gibbs, Nico, McBride and Coleman unless receiving a clear positional upgrade. Test **Jamo + a secondary piece for Jaylen Warren** (Vicks Dogg Pound), but note their WR depth is weak and their Week 11 Bijan bye may make Warren harder to acquire. Another exploratory call: **Jamo + Keenan Allen for Chase Brown** (Team DBURR6), but their RB depth and appetite for WRs must be verified; this is an opening negotiation, not an assertion the offer is fair or will be accepted. **Do not send Jamo + Coleman for Tuten** merely because Tuten scored 20.3 in Week 10; Coleman is your currently needed RB2. For a genuine buy-low, monitor **A.J. Brown's hamstring** and **Brock Bowers' ankle**, but only pursue at a substantial injury-adjusted discount. Sources: https://www.rotoballer.com/fantasy-football-trade-value-chart-week-10-trades-rankings-buys-sells-2026/1992008 and https://www.rotoballer.com/waiver-wire-express-week-11-fantasy-football-pickups-adds-2026/1994787

## Action checklist
1. **Claim Herbert or Sutton if still available**, using your current **No. 6 waiver priority** strategically; cut the surplus Colts D/ST first. If you're comfortable with Stroud, Sutton is the more directly usable bench improvement.
2. **Watch Walker's Wednesday–Friday practice reports**; start Coleman over Emmett if Walker returns to his normal role.
3. **Monitor Montgomery and Woody Marks ahead of Thursday**; do not count on Montgomery until cleared.
4. **Use Tyson as your FLEX leader over Keenan for now**, subject to snaps/practice.
5. **Check the trade deadline time in Sleeper** and pursue an RB upgrade only if the price doesn't gut your FLEX depth.
